title: Tile anchors without the app screen
description: The tile has no background location permission, so it only uses the last known location and never turns GNSS on; fresh GNSS anchors come only from the app screen. Options: request ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION and fetch a fix from a WorkManager job, or a short foreground location service. Decide on battery and permission UX first.
close_reason: Tile enqueues AnchorWorker; fresh background GNSS fix paired with barometer samples (PR #4)

title: Add README screenshots of tile and app
description: README had img links to screenshots/tile.png and screenshots/app.png that never existed; links were removed. Capture both from the Pixel Watch 4 (adb exec-out screencap -p, watch unlocked, 480x480) and add them back.
close_reason: Screenshots of tile and app captured from the Pixel Watch 4 and linked in README
